en: A sepia-toned image showing the flooded entrance gate of a brick structure, identified as the gate of a castle. The gate is an arched brick gateway with some architectural detailing on top, partially submerged in floodwater. Leafless trees and traditional European buildings are visible in the background, reinforcing a winter or early spring setting. At the bottom, Dutch text is printed.
